# telnyx_display_identity_record_verify_email (Data Source)

Whether the authorizer email of a DIR has been verified.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dir_id` (String) The dir.

### Read-Only

- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the DIR's authorizer email has been confirmed.
- `expires_at` (String) When the outstanding code stops being accepted. Null when no verification is in progress.
- `record_type` (String) Always `email_verification`.
- `sends_remaining_today` (Number) How many more codes may be requested for this DIR today. Null when the daily cap does not apply.
- `status` (String) `sent` after a code is emailed; `verified` after a successful confirm; `unverified` when no verification is in progress.
